note: Handelsbanken's fee information document (30 June 2026): the Allkonto comes in the base offer (the account, a Bankkort Start, internet and mobile banking, Swish) at 25 kronor a month, nothing for customers under 21 (or students 18 to 26 paid by CSN, or holders of its Mastercard, not modelled).
